landKey.title: Land Key
landKey.tooltip: Press while aiming at the ground to land there. Press again to cancel. Examples: B, F7, Numpad2.

landButton.title: Land Button (Controller)
landButton.tooltip: Press while aiming at the ground to land there. Press again to cancel. Options: DpadLeft, DpadRight, DpadUp, DpadDown, North, South, East, West, LeftShoulder, RightShoulder, LeftStick, RightStick, Select, Start, None.

landingSpeed.title: Landing Speed
landingSpeed.tooltip: How quickly the ship comes down and how firmly it touches down.

searchRadius.title: Search Radius (m)
searchRadius.tooltip: How far from where you aim the ship may look for a flat, clear spot.

maxSlope.title: Steepest Ground Allowed (degrees)
maxSlope.tooltip: Spots steeper than this are skipped.

cruiseClearance.title: Travel Height (m)
cruiseClearance.tooltip: How high above the landing spot the ship travels before coming down.

maxRange.title: Aiming Range (m)
maxRange.tooltip: How far away you can pick a landing spot.

showBeacon.title: Show Landing Marker
showBeacon.tooltip: Shows a thin orange beam over the spot the ship is landing on.

debugLog.title: Debug Logging
debugLog.tooltip: Writes landing details to the mod log, for reporting problems.
